# Cable Check Lab

> Cable Check Lab provides 33 free, browser-only tools for USB-C, USB Power Delivery, USB4, Thunderbolt, video adapters, DisplayPort, docks, HDMI routing, and troubleshooting.

Primary URL: https://cablechecklab.com/
Contact: canghun13@naver.com
Language: English

## Seven workbenches

- [Charging](https://cablechecklab.com/tools/charging/): Fixed PDOs, PPS, requirements, full-chain checks, port-table comparison, shared budgets.
- [Cables and data](https://cablechecklab.com/tools/cables/): Cable selection, cable/port decoding, data paths, USB4 features.
- [USB4 and Thunderbolt](https://cablechecklab.com/tools/usb4-thunderbolt/): Feature paths, tunnel budgets, port claims, cable requirements, isolation.
- [Video adapters](https://cablechecklab.com/tools/video-adapters/): Direction, active/passive conversion, feature chains, payload, MST.
- [Displays](https://cablechecklab.com/tools/displays/): Payload, HDR/VRR/HDCP/audio/DSC, lanes, MST, dock topology.
- [Docks and hubs](https://cablechecklab.com/tools/docks/): Requirements, power, USB4, data/display tradeoffs, A/B isolation.
- [HDMI routing and distribution](https://cablechecklab.com/tools/hdmi-routing/): Switch/splitter/matrix selection, capacity, EDID/downscaling, audio routes, and isolation.

## Interpretation policy

Results are calculations and declared-capability screens, not live measurements, certification, or exact-model guarantees. Unknown claims remain unknown. Exact product manuals, certified markings, operating-system telemetry, or hardware tests are required where stated.
